name: linkedin-helper-chrome-plugin
description: LinkedIn Helper: Chrome extension (Manifest V3) for LinkedIn job pages. Adds a map pin after the open job's location showing driving distance and drive time from a configurable UK postcode, an Evaluate button that gets a quick fit score and one-sentence reason from a cheap model via OpenRouter, and a Send to Claude button that opens the job as a new chat in a claude.ai project. Personal use only, loaded unpacked - not published to the Chrome Web Store.
focus: Confirm the Google Maps key path on a real job (Geomiq, London should show the Vyner St office)

run.name: Syntax check
run.command: node --check background.js && node --check content.js && node --check options.js && node --check claude.js
run.description: Parses the four extension scripts. After any change, reload the extension in chrome://extensions and refresh the LinkedIn tab.

local.notes: Installed via chrome://extensions > Developer mode > Load unpacked (this folder). No build step.

services.name: postcodes.io
services.notes: Origin postcode to coordinates. Free, no key.

services.name: Nominatim (OpenStreetMap)
services.notes: Job town to coordinates. Free, no key; max 1 request/second, personal use only.

services.name: Photon (Komoot)
services.notes: Fallback geocoder when Nominatim fails. Free, no key.

services.name: OSRM public routing
services.notes: Driving distance/time without traffic. Free demo server, with routing.openstreetmap.de as fallback.

services.name: Google Maps Platform
services.notes: Optional. Places API (New) finds the company office, Routes API gives traffic-aware drive time. Key 'LinkedJobDistanceSearchAPI' in the Intellink Google Cloud project; entered in the extension popup and stored in chrome.storage.local, never in this folder.

services.name: OpenRouter
services.notes: Evaluate button: quick job-fit score from a cheap model (default openai/gpt-6-luna, about $0.0003 per job). Key entered in the extension popup and stored in chrome.storage.local, never in this folder. Prompt is in the git-ignored triage-prompt.md.
